_comment: Copy to ./csa.config.json or ~/.claude-session-analyzer.json and fill in. Override with --config PATH or CSA_CONFIG. Run any tool with no config on a terminal to have this generated for you.
_language_comment: The built-in patterns match how one person writes in English when annoyed. Each list below ADDS alternatives and never replaces the built-ins. Entries are literal phrases and are escaped for you; prefix an entry with 're:' to supply a raw regex fragment instead. A literal is bounded so it will not fire inside a longer word.
